ios.desc:
The URL Unshortener App is your ultimate tool for revealing the original links behind shortened URLs. With a sleek, user-friendly design, it lets you effortlessly paste, scan, unshorten, and check the safety of any link — completely FREE and unlimited.

Key Features:
- Instant Unshortening: Paste a shortened link and see the original URL in seconds.
- QR Code Scanner: Quickly scan QR codes to reveal and open the links behind them.
- Safety Checks: Verify link safety with VirusTotal before clicking, for peace of mind.
- Daily Security Tips: Learn a new tip each day to stay safer online.
- History Management: Track your last 10 unshortened URLs, with easy copy and delete options.
- Clipboard Integration: Automatically detects URLs from your clipboard for faster access.

Whether you're a casual browser or a power user, the URL Unshortener App helps you browse smarter and safer. Download now and take control of your links.
